subtitle: Lesson 23 · Accounting Concepts

steps.label: An asset benefits years
steps.sub: not just the year it was purchased

steps.label: Expense all at once? No.
steps.sub: would badly violate the matching principle

steps.label: Spread the cost
steps.sub: across every period that actually benefits

steps.label: Salvage value
steps.sub: estimated worth at end of useful life

steps.label: Book value
steps.sub: cost minus accumulated depreciation so far

eyebrow: Cobalt Courier Services · example, not real data
code:
Truck: $40,000 cost, 8-year life, $4,000 salvage

Depreciable base = $40,000 - $4,000 = $36,000
Annual depreciation = $36,000 / 8 = $4,500/year

  Debit  Depreciation Expense    $4,500
  Credit Accumulated Depreciation         $4,500
caption: After 3 years: book value = $40,000 - $13,500 = $26,500.
